The '''Derived Distortion Phenomenon''' is a visual effect that affects almost all text within the presence of a [[:Category:Derived Parasites|Derived]] parasite. It is disabled by default in Creative Mode and can be modified or monitored with the command, "'''/srpguidistortion <on:off:toggle:status> [player:all]'''" (using /srpguidist is also allowed in place of /srpguidistortion).

==''Mechanics''==
When a player is in a certain radius of a Derived parasite (default is 100 blocks), GUI text will distort and become corrupted, and other graphs will become unreadable and fluctuate.

The affected GUI consists of:
*The [[Compendium]]
*All [[Module Reports]]
*Sign text
*Chat messages (not including system messages)
*Item hotbar highlights and tooltips
*Subtitles
*Potion effect HUD in the inventory (not implemented as of now)

Having [[The Sign]] effect will nullify this distortion.
